newsitem.title: FRANCE: Stabbed French culture minister will miss Cannes.
newsitem.headline: Stabbed French culture minister will miss Cannes.

text.p: French Culture Minister Philippe Douste-Blazy, stabbed by a knife-wielding assailant on Friday, will be in hospital for two weeks and will miss next week's inauguration of the Cannes film festival, doctors said on Saturday.
Douste-Blazy was attacked by a 37-year-old mental patient of Albanian origin while on an election campaign trip to his constituency at Lourdes, southwestern France, of which he is mayor.
Douste-Blazy suffered a broken rib and a lung wound, the doctors told reporters.
Press reports said the assailant, on leave for the day from a nearby mental hospital, had already attacked Douste-Blazy with a screwdriver in 1992.
